test_policy.notes: Penn State first-year applicants may choose whether to self-report SAT/ACT scores through MyPennState; no superscoring and ACT Science is not accepted. The Abington CDS C8A agrees: not required, considered if submitted.

requirements.notes: Penn State application fee is $75 for international applicants ($65 domestic). Application is the same for all Penn State campuses; the Abington campus site returned HTTP 403 to automated access, so deadlines, English minimums and fee are the university-wide Undergraduate Admissions rules and should be confirmed with Penn State Abington Admissions. Abington CDS C7: GPA very important, rigor important; essay, recommendations, interview not considered. Penn State Abington (near Philadelphia) lists 26 four-year majors (for example Accounting, Biology, Business, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Sciences, Finance, Information Technology); for other Penn State majors it offers the first two years, then students change campus (University Bulletin, Abington). First-year students usually must finish two years on the starting campus before a change of campus.

deadlines.label: Early Action (university-wide)
deadlines.notes: Apply by Nov 1 to receive a decision by Dec 24. The Abington CDS (C22) lists the same Nov 1 closing and Dec 24 notification dates.

deadlines.label: Recommended submission deadline for all applications
deadlines.notes: Dec 1 is a recommended date, not a hard closing date: the Abington CDS (C14) reports no application closing date and admission is rolling. No regular-decision notification date is published on the page.

english_policy.waiver_notes: University-wide rule. Required of international applicants whose native language is not English (US citizens and permanent residents are exempt). Alternatives: SAT EBRW 570+ (code 2660), ACT English 24+ (code 3656), GCSE/GCE English language A-C, IB English A 5+, four years at a US high school, or certification from Penn State's Intensive English Communication Program (IECP). Test scores must be under two years old; TOEFL MyBest is not accepted.

aid.notes: Penn State states there is essentially no financial aid available for international undergraduate students, and the Abington CDS (H6) reports no institutional aid for nonresidents.

tier_notes.general: Admits about 94% of applicants (93% of international applicants) with average GPA 3.20 and SAT middle 50% of 1100-1303 among submitters; the Penn State degree and name lift it slightly above open-access campuses.
